import os,re,collections,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
D=G['Demo pair 1 input']
# noise cells per quadrant with coords

            sing=[v for v,k in cc.items() if k==mn]
            winners=[v for v in sing if v==O_[i][j]]
            if len(winners)!=1 or mn!=min(cc.values()) or len(sing)>1:
                pass
            # record cases where singleton rule ambiguous or fails
            if len(set(vs))>1 and (set(vs)!={O_[i][j]}|{vs[0]}):
                pass
            rec=dict(demo=dn,i=i,j=j,vals=vs,out=int(O_[i][j]),counts=dict(cc),
                     owners=sing,win=winners[:1])
            data.append(rec)
# cases where out not equal to any singleton? and where out IS a singleton owner value
sing_ok=sum(1 for d in data if d['out'] in d['owners'] and d['counts'].get(d['out'],0)==min(d['counts'].values()))
sing_tot=sum(1 for d in data if d['out'] in d['owners'])
print('cells where out is a minority-count value:',sing_ok,'of',sing_tot)
bad=[d for d in data if d['out'] in d['owners'] and d['counts'].get(d['out'],0)!=min(d['counts'].values())]
print('wrong-singleton examples:',[(d['demo'],d['i'],d['j'],d['vals'],d['counts'],d['out']) for d in bad[:20]])
